data.title: 美狄亚 · 灯下修好的衣袖
data.description: 冬夜灯下，美狄亚穿梅紫针织长裙坐在手作桌前，给一件外套的袖口缝好最后一针。她把线轴放回木盒，抚平修补处，蓝眼里露出只属于完成一件小事的满足。
data.action: 抚平缝好的袖口，把线轴放回木盒。
data.promptProse: Medea smooths the repaired coat cuff after its last stitch and returns the thread spool to a wooden box, satisfied blue eyes above her plum knitted dress and ivory shawl. A small linen sewing apron holds remaining thread. The seated medium view includes the cool winter window behind the chair. Warm shaded lamplight reveals the mended seam, blue hair and pointed ears, with soft box-lid shadows on the tabletop.
